Horsehead Corporation, located at 300 Frankfort Road, Monaca, PA 15061-2295, stands as a prominent entity in the American metallurgical and chemical industries, particularly recognized for its significant role in zinc production and recycling. With a history that stretches back to the mid-19th century, Horsehead has established itself as a leading producer of value-added zinc products, specializing in the recycling of electric arc furnace (EAF) dust, which remains a critical challenge for the steel industry. The company’s commitment to environmental stewardship is reflected in its advanced technologies, which enable the extraction and refinement of zinc from secondary sources, thus promoting sustainability and reducing industrial waste.

Horsehead’s Monaca facility has been integral to its operations, functioning as both a major production center and a hub for technical innovation. The company provides a diversified range of chemical and metallurgical products, catering to a broad spectrum of industries including galvanizing, rubber, chemical manufacturing, and agriculture. By leveraging state-of-the-art hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical processes, Horsehead Corporation not only produces high-purity zinc and zinc oxide but also ensures responsible management of by-products and emissions.

Throughout its operational history, Horsehead has demonstrated resilience and adaptability in the face of evolving market dynamics and regulatory requirements. Its emphasis on research, employee safety, and community engagement has earned it a respected reputation among stakeholders. Today, Horsehead Corporation continues to shape the future of the zinc and chemical industries, driven by a dedication to innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction.
